title: Mortgage Loan File Fee Worksheet: Charge for a New Credit Report Pull
content:
**Standard charge.** The standard repull charge on a Mortgage Loan File is the program's credit report fee per borrower times the number of borrowers on the file, with no delivery fee, no supplement and with the borrower paying the whole of it.

**How the charge is put together.** The delivery fee and the credit supplement are added to the report cost first, and the borrower's share is applied once to that sum; the result is rounded to the cent only at the end. In the standard charge:

- the per-borrower price is the tri-merge credit report fee per borrower of the program the file is in, as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule;
- the report cost is that per-borrower price times the number of borrowers currently on the file — the same count the charge names as borrowers pulled;
- there is no delivery fee and no supplement;
- the borrower pays the whole of the sum.

## Standard charges worked through (hypothetical files)

| Program | Borrowers on the file | Per-borrower price | Report cost | Delivery fee and supplement | Borrower's share | Standard repull charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 1 | 92.40 USD | 92.40 USD | none | the whole | 92.40 USD |
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 2 | 92.40 USD | 184.80 USD | none | the whole | 184.80 USD |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 3 | 92.40 USD | 277.20 USD | none | the whole | 277.20 USD |

Each line reads: the per-borrower price times the borrowers on the file gives the report cost; with nothing added to it and the whole of it borne by the borrower, the report cost, already a whole number of cents, is the standard repull charge.
